name: logipilot
description: LogiPilot — sales-order packing, QC approval, delivery chain and stamped photo proofs.

scripts.check: node --check js/config.js && node --check js/util.js && node --check js/crypto.js && node --check js/store.js && node --check js/charts.js && node --check js/ui.js && node --check js/table.js && node --check js/auth.js && node --check js/scan.js && node --check js/photo.js && node --check js/orders.js && node --check js/router.js && node --check js/app.js && node --check js/modules/_shared.js && node --check js/modules/dashboard.js && node --check js/modules/orders.js && node --check js/modules/packing.js && node --check js/modules/delivery.js && node --check js/modules/proofs.js && node --check js/modules/settings.js
scripts.android:apk: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test:server: cd server && node --test server/test/*.test.js 2>/dev/null || (cd server && node --test test/*.test.js)
